Package info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer

Class FlightComputerSignals

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer.FlightComputerSignals
public final class FlightComputerSignals extends Object
Measured signal catalogue and per-source held state; reading never samples or draws noise.
